description: Experimental OpenAI/Broadcom Jalapeno-inspired pair; uncalibrated baseline settings, fixed compute times.
rank_represents: One abstract accelerator chip; two chips connected by a synthetic direct link.
assumptions: Sources identify the chip and describe its inference architecture; they do not establish the numerical configuration used here.
FullyConnected with two endpoints is a modeling choice, not a claim about Jalapeno internal NoC or rack topology.
50 GB/s per-direction link bandwidth, 500 ns link latency, and 10-cycle endpoint delay are inherited synthetic baseline assumptions.
local-mem-bw=1600 GB/s and peak-perf=900 TFLOPS are inherited baseline placeholders, not Jalapeno specifications. Roofline is disabled, so these values do not rescale compute durations.
Compute durations are supplied by the workload. KV-cache locality, internal tiles, memory capacity, power, and specialized kernels are not modeled.
With identical workload inputs this preset should match two_rank timing. Use it as a starting point for parameter sweeps, not to claim measured Jalapeno performance or speedup.
